summary: Xcode 16.2.0 and 26.2.0 will be removed on December 7th, 2026
replacement: Update the xcode: version in your config to a currently supported image, such as a current Xcode 26 release or later.

name: CircleCI
title: CircleCI: shallow and skip-branches query parameters removed
summary: These parameters will also be removed on December 7, 2026
replacement: Use the new responses from ?shallow=true on the projects endpoints or ?skip-branches=true on the settings endpoints.

name: CircleCI
title: CircleCI: Config validation warnings blocking pipelines (behavior change)
summary: On Dec 14, 2026, warnings will become hard failures and block pipelines: configs that still trigger them will fail validation and will not start pipelines until fixed
replacement: Fix the underlying .circleci/config.yml or orb issues flagged by config validation warnings, and check recent pipelines for warnings. Agents and the local CLI command 'circleci config validate --next' can help apply the fixes.

name: CircleCI

title: CircleCI: v1 and v1.1 trigger and rerun API endpoints deprecated
summary: They will be removed on February 1, 2027
replacement: To trigger a pipeline, use POST /api/v3/runs (API v3) or POST /api/v2/project/:provider/:organization/:project/pipeline/run (API v2 - Cloud) or POST /api/v2/project/:provider/:organization/:project/pipeline (API v2 - Server & Cloud). …
